name: Opening bell patience / first couple minutes
aliases: give the opening bell a chance
first couple minutes at the open

definitions.definition_text: Always have to give that first couple minutes at the opening bell at 9:30 New York time — does it want to retrace?
conditions: Allow first couple minutes before judging retrace behavior
definitions.variations_note: Patience / do-not-rush rule; related but not identical to FPFVG wait language.

definitions.definition_text: This is something that tells you to wait — give the opening bell a chance, and then wait for first presented fair value gap.
conditions: Early open chop / range sharing context
Then wait for FPFVG (or wait till 10:00 if no gap)
definitions.variations_note: Combines patience with FPFVG gating — also cited under first_presented_fvg.
